summary: Dry Kirkness is a West Perth chartered accounting and audit firm with a long history (farm accounting since 1945) offering tax, business advisory, bookkeeping on Xero and MYOB, and virtual CFO services. Ryan Lucas has been a Partner of the Business Services Division since July 2019. The firm's careers page cites continued growth in Business Advisory and Tax and it lists multiple open roles.
